messages:
Maya: Customer report: double-charge when reconnect replayed an in-flight toolcall (kb_search). Stream tokens + tool tokens billed.
Jordan: Runtime replay re-emitted the toolcall; ledger has no stable tool id so it wrote a second charge.
Lee: Current dedupe key (session, seq) insufficient when replay occurs across routes. We need a tool-specific id.
Sam: Billing: refunds expensive. Prefer write-time dedupe if possible. Also need clarity on quotas vs provisional holds.
Jordan: Proposal: add toolcall_uuid to StreamEvent proto and write provisional ledger rows keyed by uuid. Settle when tool_final=true. Add short TTL (30s) for provisional rows.
Maya: Console UX: surface "Provisional tokens" separately and show they reduce available quota (lock icon) until settled/expired. Product okay?
Sam: Finance: provisional holds ok if timeout short (<30s) and clearly shown.
Lee: Routing invariant: router must preserve toolcall_uuid across reroutes so dedupe works across regions/models. Add to RFC.
Jordan: Telemetry: counters for provisional_created, provisional_settled, provisional_expired, and dedupe_hits. We'll use these to tune TTL.
Maya: Implementation tasks: proto change, ledger unique index on toolcall_uuid, reconciliation sweep job, Console change, tests (cross-route e2e), and conservative canary rollout.
billing-bot: Created BILL-820 for finance review.
Maya: I'll draft RFC + proto diff. Tagging @Sam @Lee for signoff.
Jordan: I'll add feature flag and telemetry hooks.
Lee: I'll do Console mock and tooltip copy.
Sam: Sync with finance after RFC.
